comparison.objective: PR-1916 lays two robot cables into a carrier and snaps twelve crossbars shut; the candidate adjusts gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1916 tests cable routing, ordering, seating, and repeated snap-latching without strain-relief damage; the candidate tests rigid tool use and coupled torque control.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1916 requires both cables correctly routed through every closed link with adequate tails and release; the candidate requires a locked 90° stop surviving cycles.
comparison.reason: Robot-related context is shared, but cable routing and distributed latching do not measure screw-setting preservation.
